ruleDefinitions.name: Stop Windows Service Via Net.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the stopping of a Windows service via the "net" utility.

sequences.query: (((process_original_file_name = "net\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "net1\.exe") OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\net\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net1\\\.exe$"))) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ stop\\ .*"))
